report: Mercury POST-02 final writer v3 supporting structural check
scope: Local source inspection of both complete final candidates at their intended posts locations. Candidate Markdown was not edited. This report is supporting structural verification, not an Arena verdict, a complete final-validator decision, or publication approval.
verification_method: PowerShell UTF-8 reads, regular-expression source checks, XML parsing of all HTML elements, file existence checks, and SHA-256 hashing. No Python, browser, site build, or rendered-page inspection was used.

word_count_method.primary_scope: Includes byline, epistemic-status text, headings, prose, captions, Markdown table cells and image alt text. Excludes frontmatter, HTML tags, figure destinations and Markdown/table punctuation.
word_count_method.normalization: Remove frontmatter; replace Markdown images with their alt text; replace HTML tags with spaces so adjacent dt/dd text remains separate; count lexical matches.
